email.subject: Comfort Works site: quick fix for booking
email.body:
Dev,

I looked at Comfort Works Heating & Cooling's site. Two things are likely costing you calls:

1. No online booking - visitors have to call during business hours to schedule anything. Anyone searching for HVAC help at night or on weekends has no way to request service and probably just calls the next listed company.

2. Heavy, unoptimized images are slowing page load, especially on mobile. Slow-loading pages lose a chunk of visitors before they even see your services.

I fix exactly this kind of thing for a flat fee - no retainers. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing what's happening and what I'd change.

Worth a quick look?

Alex
Northlight Web
